description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Tryndamere''' becomes enraged, instantly gaining [[File:Fury resource.png|20px|link=Manaless#Fury|An icon representing the keyword Fury]] [[:Manaless#Fury|Fury]] and a [[File:Unkillable icon.png|20px|link=Death#Ways_to_prevent_dying_by_not_losing_health|An icon representing the keyword Minimum health threshold]] [[:Death#Ways_to_prevent_dying_by_not_losing_health|minimum health threshold]] for 5 seconds.
description.text: Active: Tryndamere becomes enraged, instantly gaining Fury and a minimum health threshold for 5 seconds.

description2.raw: ''Undying Rage can be used while affected by [[File:Silence icon.png|20px|link=Crowd_control#Disrupting|An icon representing the keyword Cast-inhibiting crowd control]] [[:Crowd_control#Disrupting|cast-inhibiting crowd control]].''
description2.text: Undying Rage can be used while affected by cast-inhibiting crowd control.

leveling.raw:
'''Fury Gained:'''
50 / 75 / 100
'''Minimum Health Threshold:'''
30 / 50 / 70

notes.raw: * ''Undying Rage'' will prevent [[File:Mel OriginalSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Mel|An icon representing Mel]] [[Mel|Mel's]] [[File:Mel Searing Brilliance.png|20xpx|border|link=Mel#Searing Brilliance|An icon for Mel's ability Searing Brilliance]] [[Mel#Searing Brilliance|Overwhelm's]] stacks from being consumed.
notes.text: Undying Rage will prevent Mel's Overwhelm's stacks from being consumed.
